films.blurb: Avengers, Fantastic Four and more must save the multiverse from the evil Doctor Doom
films.title: Avengers: Doomsday
films.overview: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

films.blurb: Paul increases his power across the galaxy, but there remains powerful resistance to his leadership from those closest to him
films.title: Dune: Part Three
films.overview: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

films.blurb: Billie discovers magical powers that take her into Hexe, the world of witches
films.title: Disney's Hexed
films.overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

films.blurb: Prequel set 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games
films.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
films.overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before Katniss Everdeen volunteers in her sister's place, commencing on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

films.blurb: Comedy. FBI hostage negotiator Olivia joins the Focker family. Stars Ben Stiller, Robert De Niro and Ariana Grande
films.title: Focker In-Law
films.overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, aims to marry Olivia, a strong-willed former hostage negotiator who appears to be his complete mismatch. To Greg's shock, father-in-law Jack Byrnes takes a liking to Olivia, and her unprecedented rise into his Circle of Trust sparks chaos in the family before Jack's 80th birthday party.

films.blurb: Johnny Depp is Ebenezer Scrooge in the classic Christmas tale - told like never before
films.title: Ebenezer
films.overview: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

films.blurb: Comedy with Olivia Colman. A smelly Fisherwoman finds herself a husband made from wicker, which sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos in the village

shows.venue: Islington Screen On The Green Everyman

films.title: Wicker
films.overview: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

films.blurb: A mischievous Cat takes on a mission to cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian
films.title: The Cat in the Hat
films.overview: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

films.blurb: Documentary. Before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move

shows.venue: Islington Screen On The Green Everyman

films.title: You Can See Everything
films.overview: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

films.blurb: Drama. The amazing true story of Stallone, an unknown who believed he wasn't meant to just write Rocky, but to play the lead
films.title: I Play Rocky
films.overview: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

films.blurb: Dark comedy with John Malkovich and Sam Rockwell. A trio of CIA agents snipe and bicker as they await their latest mission

shows.venue: Islington Screen On The Green Everyman

films.title: Wild Horse Nine
films.overview: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

films.blurb: Just as her career is taking off, a lawyer faces a life-altering event that forces her to reckon with her belief in the judicial system
films.title: Prima Facie
films.overview: Tessa is a brilliant British defence barrister dominating London’s ruthless courtrooms. Fierce, witty, and self-made, she defends men accused of sexual assault — until she is assaulted herself by a colleague from a powerful legal dynasty.  Suddenly, the system she trusted turns against her. As she faces the same tactics she once used in court, Tessa’s faith in justice unravels. Once in control, now exposed and disbelieved, she must fight to reclaim her voice and sense of self.

films.blurb: Thriller. Robert Pattinson stars as a journalist on reality TV series 'To Catch a Predator'
films.title: Primetime
films.overview: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.

films.blurb: Psychological thriller with Alden Ehrenreich and Helen Mirren
films.title: A Talent For Murder
films.overview: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

films.blurb: Story of the historic 1986 World Cup football match between Argentina and England
films.title: The Match
films.overview: When a legendary Go master loses his title to a one-time friend and protégé, he sets out to reclaim it in a high-stakes battle of wits and skill.

films.blurb: Horror starring Jessica Chastain. An girl encounters a sinister entity that looks like her mother
films.title: Other Mommy
films.overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

films.blurb: True story of Judith Heumann, the activist who helped fight for laws for individuals with disabilities
films.title: Being Heumann
films.overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

films.blurb: Ken Russell's blasphemous masterpiece, restored to its intended fury
films.title: Ken Russell's The Devils

films.blurb: Drama. An English school teacher and an American composer meet when both are diagnosed with Parkinson's disease
films.title: Onwards And Sideways
films.overview: Tony Evans is the deputy head of a local primary school. Emma Dretzin is a pianist, composer and single mother of two daughters. Neither knows the other until a startling encounter changes the course of their lives: on the same morning, they are both confronted with a diagnosis of Parkinson’s.

films.blurb: Drama. Five childhood friends face adult struggles
films.title: I See Buildings Fall Like Lightning
films.overview: Childhood friends Patrick, Shiv, Rian, Oli, and Conor played together, skipped school together, and dreamt of the lives they would have one day. Now they’re thirty, and the future they imagined is slipping quietly out of reach.

films.blurb: Tad and friends embark on an adventure after an ancient spell is accidentally unleashed
films.title: Tad and the Magic Lamp
films.overview: Tadeo, his girlfriend Sara, and his friends Momia, Jeff, and Belzoni embark on an adventure after Tadeo accidentally unleashes an ancient spell.
